repo:platform::platform.name: platform
repo:platform::platform.summary: Three services that talk over HTTP and a queue, plus a shared database and contract. Test data for ckb only. Never install or run it.

endpoint:gateway::POST /orders.name: POST /orders
endpoint:gateway::POST /orders.summary: Create an order, price it and publish order.created

endpoint:orders::POST /orders.name: POST /orders
endpoint:orders::POST /orders.summary: Create an order, price it and publish order.created

function:fulfillment:internal/queue/cons.name: Consume
function:fulfillment:internal/queue/cons.summary: Binds a durable queue to order.created and acks or requeues by handler result.

function:fulfillment:cmd/worker/main.go:.name: main
function:fulfillment:cmd/worker/main.go:.summary: Worker: calls the shipping API for each event and updates order status.

function:fulfillment:cmd/pricing/main.go.name: main
function:fulfillment:cmd/pricing/main.go.summary: Pricing CLI: charges a flat 999 cents per unit, ignoring SKU.

function:gateway:src/auth.js:requireAuth.name: requireAuth
function:gateway:src/auth.js:requireAuth.summary: Verifies an HS256 JWT or, when AUTH_DISABLED is set, grants admin to everyone.

function:gateway:src/auth.js:requireRole.name: requireRole
function:gateway:src/auth.js:requireRole.summary: Allows the request only when the token role matches.

function:gateway:src/server.js:route POS.name: route POST /orders
function:gateway:src/server.js:route POS.summary: Forwards an authenticated order to orders with customer_id taken from the token.

function:gateway:src/server.js:route GET.name: route GET /orders/:id
function:gateway:src/server.js:route GET.summary: Fetches one order from orders by id; no ownership check and no error handling.

function:gateway:src/server.js:route GET.name: route GET /admin/report
function:gateway:src/server.js:route GET.summary: Admin route that fetches a caller-supplied URL (SSRF sink).

function:orders:app/main.py:create_order.name: create_order
function:orders:app/main.py:create_order.summary: Prices items, inserts the order, publishes order.created, returns pending.

function:orders:app/main.py:read_order.name: read_order
function:orders:app/main.py:read_order.summary: Reads one order by id with no authentication.

function:orders:app/db.py:get_order.name: get_order
function:orders:app/db.py:get_order.summary: Looks up an order with a string-built SQL query (injection sink).

function:orders:app/db.py:insert_order.name: insert_order
function:orders:app/db.py:insert_order.summary: Inserts an order row with a parameterized query.

function:orders:app/events.py:publish_or.name: publish_order_created
function:orders:app/events.py:publish_or.summary: Publishes order.created to the orders topic exchange unless PUBLISH_EVENTS is off.

function:orders:app/pricing.py:price_ite.name: price_items
function:orders:app/pricing.py:price_ite.summary: Runs the Go pricing binary over stdin and stdout and returns total cents.
